{"database": "research_db", "query": "WITH 
-- For each CAS with duplicates, find wines (rows with largest quantity)
CAS_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        lot_id,
        quantity,
        name,
        unit,
        location,
        received,
        notes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number ORDER BY quantity DESC, lot_id ASC) as rn,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number) as total_qty,
        GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id, ', ') as all_lot_ids
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number, lot_id, name, unit, location, received, notes
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        lot_id,
        quantity,
        name,
        unit,
        location,
        received,
        notes,
        1 as rn,  -- Will be overwritten
        SUMquantity OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number) as total_qty,
        GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id, ', ') as all_lot_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT cas_number, lot_id, quantity, name, unit, location, received, notes
        FROM reagents
        WHERE cas_number IN ('7647-14-5', '77-86-1', '73-31-4')
    )
),
UNIQUE_LOT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT location, received, notes
    FROM reagents
    WHERE cas_number IN ('7647-14-5', '77-86-1', '73-31-4')
) SELECT DISTINCT name, total_qty, all_lot_ids FROM CAS_DATA WHERE rn = 1;", "summary": "Test query to find CAS data with duplicates"}
